blurb: Guests rent rafts or inflatable Funyaks and run their own whitewater trip on the Hiwassee River, which is rated Class II & III and suitable for beginners and families. The 5-mile trip winds through the Cherokee National Forest and ends in the Reliance Historic District. All necessary equipment and shuttle service to the put-in are provided.
